summary_en: Interim dividend for fiscal 2027 increased to 35 yen per share from 30 yen; year-end dividend raised to 40 yen from 35 yen, bringing full-year dividend to 75 yen.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Full-Year Consolidated Business Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Upward Revision) and Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Restar Corporation revised its dividend forecast upward for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend per share was increased from 30 yen to 35 yen, while the year-end dividend was raised from 35 yen to 40 yen. The full-year dividend per share is now projected at 75 yen. This revision follows the company's upward revision to its consolidated business forecast for the full fiscal year.
